warnings: xpath "upper-case(//data[@name='user']/@value)" starts at the document root (//data[@name='user']/@value), not at the record. Stepping hands the XSLT one record at a time, so there it finds that record's value; processing reads a stream's records as one document, where //data[@name='user']/@value finds every record's: a function taking one value fails the whole stream ("A sequence of more than one item is not allowed"), and otherwise every event gets the first record's value. Start from the record: .//data[@name='user']/@value (anywhere below it), or the path from the record's own children. Fine only for a value outside the records.
